front.title: YANG-to-P4 Configuration Mapping and Update Consistency

abstract.t: A YANG configuration can express management intent, but its acceptance does not establish that dependent entries in a programmable forwarding pipeline have become effective consistently. This document proposes an experimental mapping and update profile for P4. It describes a target-specific mapping contract, capability validation, generation-based activation, preservation of existing flow bindings, failure recovery, and operational reconciliation. The profile distinguishes configuration acceptance, verified activation, and eventual convergence. It defines neither a new packet encapsulation nor a new YANG module, and does not assume a network- wide atomic transaction.
